check_results.command: Physical Phone Gate B and post-canary pause restoration
check_results.details: At deployed commit 82187cb, the owner reported the corrected real Nimiq Pay/MainAlbatross journey working as expected and starting the PEI-qualified V10 R5 volcanic Daily match. The helper was then redeployed with PEI_PROXY_PAUSED=true; its startup log reported transfers paused on main-albatross and the deployment reached Live.

reviews.details: Primary reviewed wallet/request/parent binding, independent fresh chain verification, finality, helper secret isolation and pause guards, exact-byte persistence/rebroadcast, process/session replacement, transaction-hash visibility, same-connection PostgreSQL locking, bounded request-window de-duplication and unchanged Practice/V10 Daily authority. The bounded deployed canary subsequently passed on the owner's physical phone.

Primary reconstructed the finalized failing spend from MainAlbatross, confirmed fromType 2 and a parsed early-resolve proof whose creator is the authorized subject, and reviewed the correction against the pinned Nimiq core parser. The verifier still binds recipient, value, commitment, network, successful execution and macro finality; only the early-resolve creator can replace literal subject-sender equality. Other HTLC proof paths remain rejected.
The owner accepted Phone Gate B after the corrected real transfer journey qualified the wallet and opened the volcanic V10 Daily match.

skipped_checks: PostgreSQL integration is unavailable locally because WP014_TEST_DATABASE_URL is unset; CI must run the disposable database gate.
Daily/full release verification remains at the 22:00 Europe/Berlin or explicit release boundary.
residual_risks: The combined PEI-qualified win, claim and finalized 1 NIM MainAlbatross reward payout has not yet been exercised as one physical-phone journey; WP-013 established the payout machinery separately.

The low-funded canary has no durable helper-side sponsor budget or one-issuance-per-wallet/day rule. A returned transfer replenishes its balance and can fund another fresh earn request, so the helper remains paused outside one supervised journey and must not be opened to general users.
